rule: A tranque is a lock of the game: no player can play because all tiles of the needed suits are already played.
quote: because all pieces of the corresponding suits have been played

rule: The player who locks the game shows his tiles to the player on his right; this is called 'trancar con el de abajo'.
quote: his pieces to the player to his right, known as “tranquar con el de abajo.”

rule: If the blocker has fewer points (pips) than the player on his right, he wins and gets the points in the opponents' hands. If he has more, he loses and the points go to the opponent.
quote: has the least amount of points in his hand he wins the tranque

rule: Variant 'trancar con todo el mundo': the blocker compares with all players, and the lowest point count wins.
quote: one compares his pieces with all the players in the game

rule: On a tie in a tranque, the player who placed the first tile of that hand wins by default, and his team gets the points.
quote: In the case of a tie the player who began the game

rule: Regla general: in a tranque the pair with fewer points wins. On a tie, the pair that opened the hand wins and opens the next hand.
quote: la pareja que salió en esa mano será la ganadora

rule: Patio mode: the player who made the tranque compares only his own tiles with the opponent on his right.
quote: quien hizo el tranque compara solo sus fichas con el oponente de la derecha

rule: Santiago tournament (2019) rule 6: the tranque is decided against the player 'de abajo' (the next player).
quote: EL TRANQUE ES CON EL DE ABAJO
sourceName: Momento Deportivo RD, Copa Alcaldía de Santiago rules (2019)

rule: The same Santiago list, rule 12, also says the tranque is decided 'with everyone', pair against pair. This contradicts rule 6 in the same list.
quote: SE TRANCA CON TODOS, ES DECIR PAREJA CON PAREJA
sourceName: Momento Deportivo RD, Copa Alcaldía de Santiago rules (2019)

rule: Santiago tournament: a tied tranque scores no points. The tiles are reshuffled, and the next player in the rotation opens.
quote: SI SALE EMPATE NO VALEN LOS PUNTOS, SE BARAJA
sourceName: Momento Deportivo RD, Copa Alcaldía de Santiago rules (2019)

rule: La Guáyiga tournament (2025): the tranque is decided against the player 'de abajo'.
quote: Se tranca con el jugador de abajo.
sourceName: Junta del Distrito Municipal La Guáyiga, tournament rules (Oct 2025)

rule: Trancar means a player closes the game on purpose so that the points (tantos) are counted.
quote: cierra el juego de propósito para contar los tantos, se dice que lo “tranca”

rule: In a tranque, the pair with the fewest points wins.
quote: En el tranque, la pareja con la menor cantidad de puntos gana

rule: A humor column jokes that players have swallowed the double six so as not to lose a tranque. This shows the tranque is decided by pip count, so heavy tiles hurt.
quote: se han tragado el doble 6 para no perder un tranque
sourceName: El Día, '¡Domine mi frente!' by Bienvenido Carmona (2017)

rule: Restating DR1: after a tranque, the blocker gets the opponents' points if his tiles add up to less than those of the player on his right.
quote: add up to less than the tiles of the player to the right of him

rule: FichaFlow: the blocker compares hands with the next player, and fewer points wins. A tie goes to the blocker, and the winning side scores every point in all four hands. Other tables compare side totals.
quote: the player who blocked compares hands with the next player

rule: Generic Latin rule: a lock happens when all seven tiles of a suit are played and that suit shows on both ends. Each pair's points are counted, and the lower pair wins, not necessarily the player who locked.
quote: no gana el jugador que coloca la última ficha o ficha de cierre

rule: USA Domino Federation tournament rules: every tranque is decided pair against pair, and the pair with fewer tantos wins. On a tie nobody wins and the rotation continues.
quote: Todo tranque será en pareja. Gana la pareja con menos tantos.

rule: Ponce (Puerto Rico): the tranque is individual. Each player counts his own points, the lowest wins, and his team scores all four hands.
quote: El jugador que tenga menos puntos en mano es el ganador del tranque.

rule: International rule: on equal points in a lock, the pair with fewer tiles wins. If tiles are also equal, nothing is scored. This was the only tile-count comparison found, and it is only a tie-break.
quote: gana la pareja con menor cantidad de fichas

rule: FID definition: a hand ends in cierre or tranca when a player places the seventh and last tile of a suit and both ends then show that suit.
quote: aparte de ser la séptima y última de un palo
sourceName: Federación Internacional de Dominó, Reglamento de Juego (2015, Art. 56; same in 2024 edition)

rule: FID: in a tranca the pair with fewer points in unplayed tiles wins. It scores all unplayed tiles, both its own and the losing pair's.
quote: la pareja con menos puntos en las fichas no jugadas
sourceName: Federación Internacional de Dominó, Reglamento (2024 edition, Art. 58)

rule: FID: if both pairs have equal points, the tranca is a draw. A zero is written for the pair that made the tranca, to track hands and future openers.
quote: el cierre o tranca se considerará empate
sourceName: Federación Internacional de Dominó, Reglamento de Juego (2015, Art. 58)

rule: IDF (English edition of the FID rules): in a locked hand, the pair with the fewest points in unplayed tiles wins.
quote: the pair with the fewest points in the dominoes not played
sourceName: International Domino Federation Rules and Regulations (English, hosted by Hard Rock Tampa)

rule: FEMUNDO (the world body whose championship the Dominican federation Fededodo attends): tranques are pair against pair. On a tie the points do not count and the opener rotation continues.
quote: Los tranques son en pareja, de ocurrir un empate los puntos no cuentan

rule: FEMUNDO: in a tranque the winner scores the points of all 4 players.
quote: en un tranque, se anotan los puntos de los 4, a favor del ganador

rule: FEMUNDO allows 1 minute to think when a player is locking the game or is forced to feed the lock ('bandeo').
quote: mandar a cerrar obligado (bandeo)

rule: Dominican regla general: in a tranque the pair with fewer points wins. On a tie, the pair that opened that hand wins and also opens the next hand.
